title: National Day Special: 5,000 Years of China in Brief
titleZh: 国庆特辑：五千年中国速览
description: On National Day, Steven gives a personal tour of what "5,000 years of Chinese history" means, running from the Shang dynasty to China as the world's factory. Along the way he covers cities worth visiting, why "Hong Kong" and "Xianggang" sound so different, his favourite foods, and his girlfriend's claim that Marco Polo stole pizza from China.

sentences.zh: 内容速览
sentences.en: Quick overview

sentences.zh: 今天是国庆节，也是黄金周第一天。
sentences.en: Today is National Day, and also the first day of Golden Week.

sentences.zh: 史蒂文想回答一个大问题：大家常说“中国有五千年历史”，到底指什么？
sentences.en: Steven wants to answer a big question: people often say "China has five thousand years of history" — what exactly does that mean?

sentences.zh: 开头录砸几次后，他从商朝一路讲到现代，又聊了城市、汉语和美食。
sentences.en: After botching the opening recording a few times, he goes all the way from the Shang dynasty to modern times, and also talks about cities, the Chinese language and food.

sentences.zh: 中途女朋友插话：马可·波罗从中国“偷走”的不只是面条，还有比萨！
sentences.en: Midway, his girlfriend chimes in: Marco Polo "stole" more than just noodles from China — pizza too!

sentences.zh: 史蒂文说，这只是他在中国生活12年后的个人小导览，不是完整的历史课。
sentences.en: Steven says this is just his personal little guided tour after living in China for 12 years, not a complete history lesson.

sentences.zh: 黄金周开始啦
sentences.en: Golden Week has begun!

sentences.zh: 国庆节上午，史蒂文没去天安门，而是去上了早上10点的中文课。
sentences.en: On the morning of National Day, Steven didn't go to Tiananmen; instead, he went to a 10 a.m. Chinese class.

sentences.zh: 他纳闷自己怎么会约在这天上课，估计老师也一样纳闷。
sentences.en: He wondered why he had scheduled a class on this day, and figured his teacher was wondering the same thing.

sentences.zh: 他放七天假，10月9日回去上班。
sentences.en: He has seven days off and goes back to work on October 9.

sentences.zh: 节目灵感来自在中国当老师都听过的一句话：“众所周知，中国有五千年历史。”
sentences.en: The episode was inspired by a line every teacher in China has heard: "As everyone knows, China has five thousand years of history."

sentences.zh: 他让ChatGPT帮忙设计节目，却发现它推荐的地方漏了成都、重庆、哈尔滨、新疆和西藏。
sentences.en: He had ChatGPT help plan the episode, but found that the places it recommended left out Chengdu, Chongqing, Harbin, Xinjiang and Tibet.

sentences.zh: 节目简介附有哥伦比亚大学的历史年表，还有一份AI生成的文档，他承认那份文档“有点枯燥”。
sentences.en: The show notes include a historical timeline from Columbia University, plus an AI-generated document that he admits is "a bit dry."

sentences.zh: 从甲骨文到唐朝
sentences.en: From oracle bone script to the Tang dynasty

sentences.zh: 商周以前： 各地文化分散，甲骨文和古埃及象形文字差不多同时出现。
sentences.en: Before the Shang and Zhou: cultures were scattered across different regions, and oracle bone script appeared at about the same time as ancient Egyptian hieroglyphs.

sentences.zh: 商周： 孔子约生活在公元前500年，和古希腊哲学家同时代，孙子、老子、孟子也出自这一时期。
sentences.en: Shang and Zhou: Confucius lived around 500 BC, contemporary with the ancient Greek philosophers, and Sun Tzu, Laozi and Mencius also came from this period.

sentences.zh: 史蒂文读过中文版《孙子兵法》，觉得“特别短促”，一个字能顶六个英文词。
sentences.en: Steven has read the Chinese edition of The Art of War and found it "especially terse" — one character can do the work of six English words.

sentences.zh: 秦汉： 秦始皇留下了西安兵马俑。
sentences.en: Qin and Han: Qin Shi Huang left behind the Terracotta Warriors of Xi'an.

sentences.zh: 唐： 唐诗的黄金时代，长安是贸易中心。
sentences.en: Tang: the golden age of Tang poetry, when Chang'an was a center of trade.

sentences.zh: 他推荐一部新电影：妃子想吃南方的新鲜荔枝，为此死了许多人，她却一颗也没尝到。
sentences.en: He recommends a new film: an imperial consort wants to eat fresh lychees from the south, many people die for it, yet she never gets to taste a single one.

sentences.zh: 宋、元、明
sentences.en: Song, Yuan, Ming

sentences.zh: 宋朝商业和印刷业繁荣。
sentences.en: Commerce and printing flourished in the Song dynasty.

sentences.zh: 《金刚经》868年就已雕版印刷，毕昇约1040年发明活字印刷，比德国美因茨早了四百年。
sentences.en: The Diamond Sutra was already woodblock-printed in 868, and Bi Sheng invented movable-type printing around 1040, four hundred years earlier than Mainz in Germany.

sentences.zh: 元朝是蒙古人统治的时代，如今内蒙古大多数人说普通话，但蒙古文仍在使用。
sentences.en: The Yuan dynasty was an era of Mongol rule. Today most people in Inner Mongolia speak Mandarin, but the Mongolian script is still in use.

sentences.zh: 明朝派郑和下西洋。
sentences.en: The Ming dynasty sent Zheng He on voyages to the Western Seas.

sentences.zh: 有本书叫《1421》，说中国船队比哥伦布更早到美洲，史蒂文只回了一句：“行吧。”
sentences.en: There's a book called 1421 that says a Chinese fleet reached the Americas before Columbus; Steven's only reply was, "Sure, okay."

sentences.zh: 明朝修建了紫禁城，但许多珍宝在台北故宫，所以故宫其实“一分为二”。
sentences.en: The Ming dynasty built the Forbidden City, but many of its treasures are in the National Palace Museum in Taipei, so the Palace Museum is really "split in two."

sentences.zh: 旅行小贴士： 故宫门票只能在网上预约未来七天内的时段；天安门广场也要预约。
sentences.en: Travel tip: Palace Museum tickets can only be booked online for time slots within the next seven days; Tiananmen Square also requires a reservation.

sentences.zh: 黄金周如果迟到，可能就进不去了。
sentences.en: If you're late during Golden Week, you might not get in.

sentences.zh: 从清朝覆灭到“世界工厂”
sentences.en: From the fall of the Qing dynasty to the "world's factory"

sentences.zh: 清： 鸦片战争开启了“百年屈辱”，香港割让给英国，1997年回归。
sentences.en: Qing: The Opium War began the "century of humiliation"; Hong Kong was ceded to Britain and returned in 1997.

sentences.zh: 1912年后： 史蒂文把清朝灭亡比作罗马衰落。
sentences.en: After 1912: Steven compares the fall of the Qing dynasty to the decline of Rome.

sentences.zh: 约30年内战之后，1949年10月1日新中国成立。
sentences.en: After about 30 years of civil war, the People's Republic of China was founded on October 1, 1949.

sentences.zh: 日本侵华： 南京和东北的记忆至今“隐隐作痛”。
sentences.en: The Japanese invasion of China: memories of Nanjing and the Northeast still "ache faintly" to this day.

sentences.zh: 毛泽东时代： 土地、教育和家庭生活都被重塑。
sentences.en: The Mao Zedong era: land, education and family life were all reshaped.

sentences.zh: 70年代，北京取代台湾获得联合国席位。
sentences.en: In the 1970s, Beijing replaced Taiwan and gained the UN seat.

sentences.zh: 邓小平： 80年代起，中国从农业转向制造业，至今仍是世界工厂，“只是标签换了”。
sentences.en: Deng Xiaoping: from the 1980s on, China shifted from agriculture to manufacturing and is still the world's factory today — "only the label has changed."

sentences.zh: 年表里还有一首用《两只老虎》调子唱的朝代歌：“商周秦汉，隋唐宋……”
sentences.en: The timeline also has a dynasty song sung to the tune of "Two Tigers": "Shang, Zhou, Qin, Han, Sui, Tang, Song…"

sentences.zh: 史蒂文提醒：听了就停不下来。
sentences.en: Steven warns: once you hear it, you can't stop.

sentences.zh: 值得了解的城市
sentences.en: Cities worth getting to know

sentences.zh: 史蒂文的前三名：北京看政治历史，上海看“现代化的巅峰”，西安则是古都长安，北京长安街就因它得名。
sentences.en: Steven's top three: Beijing for its political history, Shanghai for the "peak of modernization," and Xi'an, the ancient capital Chang'an, which Beijing's Chang'an Avenue is named after.

sentences.zh: 南京、长沙、吐鲁番、喀什也值得去。
sentences.en: Nanjing, Changsha, Turpan and Kashgar are also worth visiting.

sentences.zh: 西藏他还没去过，那里需要特别许可，很多人还会有高原反应。
sentences.en: He hasn't been to Tibet yet; you need a special permit to go there, and many people also get altitude sickness.

sentences.zh: 香港与汉语大家族
sentences.en: Hong Kong and the big Chinese language family

sentences.zh: “Hong Kong”和“Xianggang”为什么差别这么大？
sentences.en: Why are "Hong Kong" and "Xianggang" so different?

sentences.zh: 其实是同两个字，一个粤语读，一个普通话读。
sentences.en: They're actually the same two characters: one read in Cantonese, the other in Mandarin.

sentences.zh: 史蒂文说，这期你只记住这一点就够了。
sentences.en: Steven says that if you remember just one thing from this episode, this is enough.

sentences.zh: 中文是一个语言家族，主要分支是普通话和粤语，还有上海话、闽南话等。
sentences.en: Chinese is a family of languages; its main branches are Mandarin and Cantonese, plus Shanghainese, Hokkien and others.

sentences.zh: 港台用繁体字，大陆从50年代起推行简化字和拼音。
sentences.en: Hong Kong and Taiwan use traditional characters, while the mainland has promoted simplified characters and pinyin since the 1950s.

sentences.zh: 史蒂文卡在HSK五级，上课能听懂八九成，但“语法很烂”。
sentences.en: Steven is stuck at HSK level 5: he can understand 80–90% in class, but his "grammar is terrible."

sentences.zh: 书、电影和美食
sentences.en: Books, films and food

sentences.zh: 他觉得近十几年中国电影“有趣多了”，从悲叹历史转向生活喜剧。
sentences.en: He thinks Chinese films over the last ten-odd years have become "a lot more fun", moving from lamenting history to comedies about everyday life.

sentences.zh: 推荐美食：
sentences.en: Recommended dishes:

sentences.zh: 锅包肉和糖醋里脊： 当年他第一次念“糖醋里脊”，学生们笑成一团。
sentences.en: Guobaorou and sweet-and-sour pork tenderloin: the first time he said "tangcu liji" out loud, his students burst out laughing.

sentences.zh: 包子和油条： “印刷术都发明了，却从没给油条撒糖，所以甜甜圈的功劳算不到中国头上。”
sentences.en: Baozi and youtiao: "They invented printing, but never once sprinkled sugar on youtiao, so China can't take credit for the doughnut."

sentences.zh: 热干面和肉夹馍： 后者“像汉堡，又不是汉堡”。
sentences.en: Hot dry noodles and roujiamo: the latter is "like a hamburger, but not a hamburger".

sentences.zh: 这时女朋友回来拿钥匙，说马可·波罗还偷走了比萨，证据是馅饼：馅包在里面，而不是铺在上面。
sentences.en: Just then his girlfriend came back for her keys and said Marco Polo also stole pizza, the proof being xianbing: the filling is wrapped inside rather than spread on top.

sentences.zh: 她还顺手纠正了史蒂文的声调。
sentences.en: While she was at it, she also corrected Steven's tones.

sentences.zh: 今日总结
sentences.en: Today's summary

sentences.zh: 被生活琐事缠身时，比如催房东修马桶，人很容易忘了中国悠久的历史。
sentences.en: When you're bogged down by life's little chores, like pestering your landlord to fix the toilet, it's easy to forget China's long history.

sentences.zh: 这期节目正好提个醒。
sentences.en: This episode is the perfect reminder.

sentences.zh: 国庆节快乐！
sentences.en: Happy National Day!

vocab.en: to ache faintly; to still sting
